python3 -c "
import subprocess, time, sys
t0 = time.perf_counter()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'csvsum.py'], stdin=open('data.csv', 'rb'), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
if p.returncode != 0:
    print(0)
    sys.exit(1)
exp = open('expected.txt', 'rb').read()
if p.stdout != exp:
    print(0)
    sys.exit(1)
print(f'{2000000.0 / dt:.1f}')
"
